reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel, simultaneous coupling of high-speed DSC and in-situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction to directly measure multiple melting parameters (temperature, enthalpy, entropy, volume change) in HEAs. No passage describes or suggests this integrated experimental setup; existing work uses DSC and diffraction separately or for different purposes (e.g., P21 uses them sequentially on oxides, P45 uses DSC and STEM). The idea of correlating heat flow and real-time structural data to minimize uncertainties and extract liquid-phase properties is a non-trivial synthesis not found in the literature.
